refnamediv.refpurpose: Calculate coefficients of an autoregressive (AR) model of complex data.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: a = arburg(x, poles) a = arburg(x, poles, criterion) [a, v] = arburg(...) [a, v, k] = arburg(...)

listitem.para: Vector of real or complex numbers, of length > 2.
String value, takes in "AKICc", "KIC", "AICc", "AIC", and "FPE". Default is not using a model-selection criterion.
Mean square of residual noise from the whitening operation of the Burg lattice filter.
Reflection coefficients defining the lattice-filter embodiment of the model.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: This function calculates coefficients of an autoregressive (AR) model of complex data `x` using the whitening lattice-filter method of Burg. The first argument is the data sampled. The second argument is the number of poles in the model (or limit in case a criterion is supplied). The third parameter takes in the criterion to limit the number of poles. The acceptable values are "AIC", "AKICc", "KIC", "AICc", which are based on information theory.
